policy: Measured result numeric rows and identities unchanged; path policy applied only if present.

payload.Scope: Constructed value primitives only: diagnostics-disabled hook bundle, exact-key/witness scopes, opt-in recorder storage and refusal. No authority session, native collision/Emit/payment, geometry admission, replay, frame-step, gameplay or FPS claim. Storage is the production opt-in recorder implementation; it is not active Shadow gameplay.

ByteCapSetup.Note: Payload budget excludes array/list/object headers; caller allocations include those. Initial refusal also occurs in setup.

payload.Measurement: 30 raw serial batch totals after eight warmups per case. Process CPU includes all threads; allocation bytes count the caller thread. Delegate/no-inline wrapper/consume and loop costs included. Preparation, assertions, reflection, enumeration and JSON reporting outside timed intervals. Prior setup/validation GC can affect later timings: no forced collection or sample filtering. Median/p95/p99/p99.9 describe batch totals, never per-operation/frame tails.
payload.AllocationPolicy: All observed zero/nonzero counts retained for every case; no warmed-zero allocation assertion or guarantee. Unexplained small nonzero in-page counts in prior attempt are preserved, not causally attributed to engine/JIT allocation without further evidence.
